correctness.rationale: From two fully occupied CTMCs, independently constructed 7-state transient generators using unit extinction and path rate 3r/2 vs triangle rate r. Symbolic reduction to 3- and 5-state chains yields Ltri=6/Dtri and Lpath=6(2r+s+1)(3r+s+2)/Dpath, difference =3r^2s*positive_polynomial/(2Dtri Dpath)>0. Nonsingular M-matrix ensures denominators positive. Analytic s→0 gives positive mean gap and Q^5 expansion gives 3r² t^5/80, not pointwise survival dominance. Independently checked determinant, resolvent, mean and fifth-order coefficients with SymPy.
